1.en: Figure 1. Overall architecture of the Zebrafish Knowledge Hub and the scale of its curated resources. (A) Three-module architecture: a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) knowledge base indexing 32,532 papers as 7,651,942 semantic chunks across 170 FAISS shards, a manually curated gene database and an integrated toolkit, coordinated by an agent orchestrator that returns grounded answers with inline citations. (B) Dual anchoring of gene records: all 26,321 curated genes, the subset carrying an Ensembl identifier (96.6%), and those cross-mapped onto the latest assembly GRCz12tu (86.0%). (C) Curated annotation resources available for each gene, including GO annotations, KEGG pathway links, cross-references, literature links, expression records and aliases, plotted on a logarithmic scale.
1.zh: 图 1. 斑马鱼知识中枢的总体架构与资源规模。(A) 三模块架构：覆盖 32,532 篇文献（7,651,942 个语义块、170 个 FAISS 分片）的 RAG 知识库、人工策展基因数据库与集成工具集，由智能体编排器统一调度，输出带行内引用的可溯源答案。(B) 基因记录的双重锚定：26,321 条策展基因中，携带 Ensembl 标识者占 96.6%，成功映射到最新组装 GRCz12tu 者占 86.0%。(C) 每个基因可用的策展注释资源（对数坐标）。

2.en: Figure 2. Construction of the full-text corpus and gold-standard quality control. (A) Funnelling of the literature corpus: 32,549 free-text records, 32,532 of which are indexed for retrieval, with 16,386 entering the gold-standard audit and 11,918 passing it; percentages denote stage-to-stage retention. (B) Pass rate of the gold-standard criterion in the two corpus pools, showing the number of accepted and rejected documents. (C) Quality gate: a minimal body length of 35,487 characters, three permitted full-text sources, and a random re-audit of 120 gold documents after indexing in which all documents remained gold, with no pending vectors; the corpus is written into a 170-shard FAISS index holding 7,651,942 semantic chunks.

3.en: Figure 3. Retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. (A) Offline indexing: 32,532 full texts are cleaned of non-scientific material, split at paragraph boundaries with section weighting, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-4B into 2048-dimensional vectors and written into 170 FAISS shard files, yielding 7,651,942 semantic chunks (index version qwen3_4b_v2_short_section, updated 2026-09-10). (B) Online pipeline: the session-aware rewritten query is scored coarsely over papers, the best 500 of which are rescored by a cross-encoder reranker; the top 100 papers are packed into a 48,000-character context for grounded generation under a fixed answer contract (direct first sentence, factor-wise organisation, inline citations and a reference footer without dangling citations).
3.zh: 图 3. 检索增强生成管线。(A) 离线建库：32,532 篇全文先清除非科学内容，按自然段切分并按章节加权，用 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 嵌入为 2048 维向量并写入 170 个 FAISS 分片，共产生 7,651,942 个语义块（索引版本 qwen3_4b_v2_short_section，更新于 2026-09-10）。(B) 在线问答：结合会话上下文改写问题后按篇粗打分，取最优 500 篇经交叉编码器精细重排，前 100 篇按 48,000 字符预算打包为上下文，按固定答案契约生成可溯源回答（首句直答、按因素组织、行内引用 [n]、文末参考文献无悬空引用）。

4.en: Figure 4. Benchmark design, scoring rubric and retrieval fidelity. (A) Composition of the 100-question benchmark across 9 question categories. (B) Seven-dimension scoring rubric (10 points in total) used for blind pairwise assessment of two systems answering the same question. (C) Retrieval-fidelity probes executed on the production 32,532-paper index, in which the title of an indexed document is used as the query (the probe PMID identifier of each document is listed on the left): all 5/5 probe documents were recalled inside the top-100 reranked set (self-rank 14-56), confirming that index sharding preserves recall, while rank 1 is occupied by semantically closest papers of the full corpus.
4.zh: 图 4. 评测体系设计、评分量表与检索保真度。(A) 100 题基准在 9 个问题类别上的构成。(B) 七维评分量表（共 10 分），用于两系统同题盲评对照。(C) 在正式索引（32,532 篇）上执行的检索保真度探针：以已入库文献标题作为查询（左侧列出探针 PMID），5/5 篇探针文献均被召回到前 100 重排结果内（自身排名 14-56），表明分片索引未丢失内容；rank 1 由全库中语义最接近的文献占据。

6.en: Figure 6. Gene entity normalisation and cross-assembly mapping. (A) Raw identifiers extracted from the literature, which stem from several assembly versions and historical naming conventions, are resolved through an alias and collision-handling stage into non-redundant canonical gene records, which are subsequently mapped onto the latest assembly GRCz12tu; every historical identifier remains queryable. (B) Coverage of the curated gene records with respect to Ensembl identifiers, assembly mapping, literature and expression evidence. (C) Per-gene integrated annotation resources, including GO annotations and KEGG pathway links.
6.zh: 图 6. 基因实体归一化与跨组装映射。(A) 从文献中抽取的原始标识符源自多个组装版本与历史命名体系，经别名解析与冲突消解后归并为非冗余的规范基因记录，再映射到最新组装 GRCz12tu；所有历史标识符仍可检索。(B) 策展基因记录在标识符、组装映射、文献证据与表达证据四个方面的覆盖率。(C) 每个基因整合的注释资源。

5.en: Figure 5. End-to-end acceptance testing of the deployed Hub. (A) The nine-layer acceptance suite comprises static integrity, data completeness, tool behaviour, API contract, answer quality, front-end rendering, robustness and security, performance, and repeat-stability checks; the bars give the number of automated assertions per layer, all of which passed in the reported runs. (B) Wall-clock cost of each layer; the retrieval- and generation-bound layers dominate the total runtime, whereas static and tool layers complete in a few seconds.
5.zh: 图 5. 已部署知识中枢的端到端验收测试。(A) 九层验收套件覆盖静态完整性、数据完备性、工具行为、API 契约、答案质量、前端渲染、稳健性与安全、性能与重复稳定性；条形表示各层的自动化断言数量，报告轮次中全部通过。(B) 各层实测耗时；检索与生成相关层次占据主要运行时间，静态检查与工具层仅需数秒。

9.en: Figure 9. Text-cleaning and chunking pipeline of the knowledge base. (A) Six implementation-aligned stages: text normalisation, section parsing into 11 canonical sections, noise truncation, figure-artefact scrubbing, paragraph splitting (max 360 / min 110 / overlap 48 characters) and weighted embedding into 170 FAISS shards at 2048 dimensions. (B) Rule set with the measured trigger rate of each rule; the two truncation rules are position-gated, so the values shown are the fractions that actually fired (34.1% and 47.8%), not the fractions where a heading merely exists. (C) Measured effect on 999 gold full texts sampled from the local gold corpus: the average body length drops from 56,122 to 46,904 characters (−17.4% removed as non-scientific material), yielding 193 paragraphs of 289 characters on average per paper. Scope and limits: paragraph counts characterise this sampled corpus only; the production index applies section-aware chunking (7,651,942 chunks over 32,532 papers, 235.2 chunks per paper), and 7.2% of the sampled bodies are capped at 120,000 characters. An independent draw with a different seed moves the mean body length by 3.4%.
9.zh: 图 9. 知识库的文本清洗与切分流水线。(A) 六个与实现对齐的环节：文本归一化、章节解析（11 类规范章节）、噪声段截断、图注伪影清理、自然段切分（上限 360 / 下限 110 / 重叠 48 字符）与加权嵌入（2048 维，写入 170 个 FAISS 分片）。(B) 规则集及各规则的实测触发率；两条截断规则按位置门控，故所列数值为「实际触发」占比（34.1% 与 47.8%），而非「仅检测到标题」的占比。(C) 对自本地金标语料抽样的 999 篇全文实测：正文平均长度由 56,122 字符降至 46,904 字符（去除 17.4% 的非科学内容），每篇平均得到 193 个自然段、段均 289 字符。范围与限度：段数仅刻画该抽样语料；生产索引采用章节感知切分（共 7,651,942 块 / 32,532 篇，即 235.2 块每篇），且样本中 7.2% 的正文受 120,000 字符上限截断；换用不同种子的独立抽样使正文均值变动 3.4%。

10.en: Figure 10. Representative question-answering case comparing the Hub with a general-purpose large language model. The question asks which reference assemblies are commonly used for zebrafish and which one is current. (A) The Hub names the current reference GRCz12tu and its GRCz11 anchor used for gene identifiers, and lists curated resources (Ensembl, GO, KEGG) with entry-level PMID citations. (B) A general model answers the same question without domain retrieval. (C) Coverage matrix of eight independently verifiable facts: the Hub satisfies all 8 of 8 completely, whereas the general model states 1 completely, 1 partially and omits the remaining 6, notably naming the latest assembly imprecisely and mis-stating its release year and annotation release. The Hub answer is taken from a real production run (logs/_a3_answer.txt); the comparison answer was produced by calling a general-purpose API with the same question (logs/_llm_compare_deepseek.txt). Verified against NCBI on 2026-09-28: GCF_049306965.1 (GRCz12tu) was released on 4 April 2025, and NCBI now marks it as replaced by GCF_049306965.2; the accession cited was current when the answer was produced.
10.zh: 图 10. 代表性问答实例：本知识中枢与通用大模型的对比。问题为“斑马鱼参考基因组有哪些常用版本、当前最新版本是什么”。(A) 本中枢给出现行参考组装 GRCz12tu 与用于基因标识的锚定组装 GRCz11，并列出策展资源（Ensembl、GO、KEGG）及条目级 PMID 引用。(B) 通用模型在无领域检索的情况下回答同一问题。(C) 八个可独立核实的事实要点覆盖矩阵：本中枢 8/8 项完整；通用模型 1 项完整、1 项部分、其余 6 项缺失——尤其最新组装命名不精确，并误报了发布年份与注释版本。本中枢回答取自真实生产运行日志 logs/_a3_answer.txt；对照回答为以同一问题实调通用模型 API 的结果（logs/_llm_compare_deepseek.txt）。已于 2026-09-28 按 NCBI 记录核实：GCF_049306965.1（GRCz12tu）发布于 2025-04-04，且 NCBI 现已将其标注为被 GCF_049306965.2 取代，故本图引用的接入号为回答生成时的现行版本。
